# Stock ledger and reservations

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../packages/stock)

Record stock movements, maintain balances and manage time-limited reservations through a shared service.

**Scope:** Stock ledger and policy code using host-owned card tables; does not grant stock-write or production-database authority.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `@cambridge-tcg/stock`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. Reader, writer, reservation, reconciliation and event modules plus tests are present. The README specifies atomic movement-and-balance writes.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Keep all stock mutations on the shared writer and verify idempotency and reservation behavior for changes.
